label: Fullerton Composite Squadron 56
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

ground_removed.colour: none: the ground was already clear (alpha 3 or less, white or black colour under it)
ground_removed.flood: 4-neighbour flood from the picture's edge over pixels with alpha 3 or less

band.rule: alpha from the pixel colour's place between white and the outline's solid colour, colour taken from the outline

provenance: Unit emblem of Fullerton Composite Squadron 56 (PCR-CA-295), digital artwork sent by the owner, 2026-11-18, as the unit's official digital emblem. Official digital artwork shipped as given: png (8-bit RGBA), 485 x 486 px, 8-bit RGBA; the file came with its ground already clear but with a pale fringe: the edge pixels were blended with white (alpha rose over a few pixels while the colour was pale; 1764 of 2656 edge pixels lighter than both the surface and the outline on the OCP, 0 on navy). The 2618 px of that edge were given their alpha from where their colour lies between white and the outline's own solid colour (#ff7f00) and took that colour (233 of them are clear; 12 lighter than both on the OCP and 0 on navy afterwards); the picture was trimmed to the emblem's box (485 x 486 px to 484 x 481 px); every pixel inside the emblem's outline is untouched; no resampling, no redrawing, no tracing, no other colour change. Charter: PCR-CA-295 is the unit the owner named for this emblem, which reads FULLERTON COMP SQ 56; the builder's unit list names it FULLERTON COMPOSITE SQDN 56.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only changes are the pale edge made a clean outline, and the trim to the emblem's box.
